***Expeditions: Atlantic City***, also known simply as ***Fallout 76: Atlantic City***, is a series of updates for *Fallout 76*. It was preceded by *Once in a Blue Moon*. It was released in two waves of updates, the first of which, ***Boardwalk Paradise***, released on December 5, 2023. The second update, ***America's Playground***, released on March 26, 2024. [1] [2] [3] *America's Playground* was followed by *Skyline Valley*. [4] 

It features the eponymous Atlantic City in the second Expedition for the game. [5] *Boardwalk Paradise* (patch 48) introduced Atlantic City via two new Expedition missions. *America's Playground* (patch 50) implemented open exploration of Atlantic City and four new main quests within it. [6] [3] 

This page serves as an overview of both updates, *Boardwalk Paradise* and *America's Playground*, even as they were released at different intervals, providing a combined look at the Atlantic City content added from December 2023 - March 2024. Update-specific overviews can be found at the respective pages for *Boardwalk Paradise* and *America's Playground*.

The Road to Atlantic City trailer, which announced the update, references the lyrics of the 1982 song "Atlantic City" by Bruce Springsteen. The line *"Put your Rad-Shield on and fix your hair up pretty, because we're headed for the boardwalk of Atlantic City"* refers to the lyric *"Put your makeup on and fix your hair up pretty, and meet me tonight in Atlantic City."*
